learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about different types of families, how we help each other, and why our friends are so special!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A family is a group of people who live together, love, and care for each other. Some families are small with parents and children, and some are very big with grandparents, uncles, and aunts!
We all do different small jobs at home to help our parents. Sharing work makes everyone happy and gives us more free time to play and have fun together!
Friends are the people we love to play games with, talk to, and share our toys with. We learn so many exciting new things when we are with our best friends!
When someone in our family or a friend is feeling sad or sick, we make sure to take extra care of them. A warm hug or a kind word can quickly make them smile again!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw Your Family Tree!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a big piece of paper and draw a beautiful green tree. Draw apples or leaves and write the names of your family members inside them, then color it beautifully!

quick_recap: ⭐ A family is made of people who love and support each other every day.
⭐ We should always try to help our parents with small jobs around the house.
⭐ Friends make our lives fun and teach us how to share our things.
⭐ Caring for the people around us makes our world a very happy place!
